dimensions.priority_signal: High priority. Completely breaks the Kiro CLI cook workflow. Every loop iteration using Kiro with a task ID fails. Existing tests assert the broken behavior and need updating.

rationale: Well-documented, verified bug. The task_injection workaround for Kiro bug #4141 now actively breaks @prompt expansion in newer Kiro CLI versions, rendering the cook phase non-functional. The fix is straightforward and a PR (#15) was already created by the bot.
